programmes.name_en: Argentine R&D&i Agency - FONTAR and FONSOFT instruments
programmes.funder: Agencia Nacional de Promoción de la Investigación, el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (Agencia I+D+i), Argentina
programmes.amount_note: FONTAR (technological modernisation) and FONSOFT (software industry) provide non-reimbursable grants and subsidised credit for company R&D and for software startups. Ceilings are set per convocatoria and are re-denominated frequently because of inflation.
programmes.deadline_note: The Agencia issues numbered convocatorias with fixed windows. Under the current administration's fiscal consolidation, several historic instruments have been suspended or merged, so confirm which lines are active before preparing an application.
programmes.reopen_note: Argentina's innovation funding has been substantially restructured and reduced since 2024. Open convocatorias are listed at https://www.argentina.gob.ar/ciencia/agencia/convocatorias - check that page rather than assuming a historic line such as EMPRETECNO or PICT Start-Up is still running.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the Agencia's convocatorias page for an open FONTAR or FONSOFT line.
Register the company in the Agencia's system.
Submit the project with budget and counterpart.
Evaluation and, on approval, contract with milestone disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Argentine companies; most lines require a counterpart contribution and, for credit lines, collateral.

programmes.name_local: Régimen de Promoción de la Economía del Conocimiento (Ley 27.506 y modificatorias)
programmes.funder: Secretaría de Industria y Comercio, Ministerio de Economía, Argentina
programmes.amount_note: Registered companies receive a reduced corporate income tax rate, a non-transferable tax credit bond worth a percentage of employer social security contributions (higher for new hires from priority groups), and stability of the benefits. The value depends on payroll, not on a fixed grant.
programmes.deadline_note: Registration in the Registro Nacional de Beneficiarios del Régimen de Promoción de la Economía del Conocimiento (EDC) is open on a rolling basis, with annual recertification.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm at least 70% of revenue comes from promoted knowledge-economy activities.
Meet one of three additional requirements (R&D spending, staff training, or exports).
Register through the TAD platform in the EDC registry.
Annual recertification and reporting to keep the benefits.

documents_required.doc: Audited revenue breakdown by promoted activity
Evidence of R&D spend, training or exports

eligibility.other_note: Argentine companies deriving at least 70% of revenue from software, audiovisual, biotechnology, professional export services, nanotechnology, aerospace, AI, robotics and related promoted activities. Micro and small companies face lighter additional requirements.
